genomes.name: Inside Day in an Uptrend
genomes.thesis: An inside day above the 50-day is a pause before continuation.
genomes.rationale: generation 0, written by Claude for this island

entry_rules.when: high < prev(high) and low > prev(low) and close > sma50

genomes.name: Gap-Down Reversal
genomes.thesis: A gap down of 0.8% that closes above its open.
genomes.rationale: generation 0, written by Claude for this island

genomes.name: Outside Reversal Day
genomes.thesis: A new low that closes above yesterday's close.
genomes.rationale: generation 0, written by Claude for this island

genomes.name: Hammer Above the 50
genomes.thesis: A long lower wick: the low is well under the open and the close is near the high.
genomes.rationale: generation 0, written by Claude for this island

entry_rules.when: (min(open, close) - low) > 2 * abs(close - open) and (close - low) / (high - low + 0.0001) > 0.6 and close > sma50

genomes.name: Three Lower Lows
genomes.thesis: Three lower lows in a row above the 200-day.
genomes.rationale: generation 0, written by Claude for this island

entry_rules.when: low < prev(low) and prev(low) < prev(prev(low)) and close > sma200

genomes.name: Narrow Range Day
genomes.thesis: The narrowest range in a while above the 50-day: expansion follows.
genomes.rationale: generation 0, written by Claude for this island

entry_rules.when: (high - low) / close < atr_pct * 0.6 and close > sma50
